extZaloPersonal.capture.armedNone: Nothing is being captured yet. Allow a contact below and save.
extZaloPersonal.capture.bothSides: From that same moment, your own replies are captured too, not only the customer's messages. When you answer from Zalo on your phone or Zalo PC, Zalo delivers that message to us the way it delivers it to your other devices — nothing here reads your phone — so an allowed conversation reads as a conversation rather than one-sided. A reply you send from the CRM is still recorded once, not twice.
extZaloPersonal.capture.defaultDeny: Nothing is captured by default: a contact you have not chosen is not captured at all. Choosing is yours, and you take it back by blocking a contact.
extZaloPersonal.capture.empty: No contacts to show yet. They appear here as Zalo reports them, and nothing is captured meanwhile.
extZaloPersonal.capture.emptyNoRoster: Zalo did not answer just now, so there is nothing to list — which is not the same as having no contacts. Try again in a moment.
extZaloPersonal.capture.forward: Capture runs forward from the moment you save: messages that arrive after that, plus whatever Zalo was still holding for you. Your earlier conversations are not fetched — Zalo does not hand them over.
extZaloPersonal.capture.noRoster: Zalo did not answer just now, so this list is only the contacts you have already ruled on. You can still change any of them, and saving works as usual.
extZaloPersonal.capture.saveFailed: Your choices may not have been saved. Check the list above before trying again.
extZaloPersonal.capture.sub: Your own list, and only yours — nobody sets this up for you. This is what Zalo reported, plus everyone you have already ruled on.
extZaloPersonal.capture.title: Which conversations are captured
extZaloPersonal.capture.unsaved: Not saved yet. Capture starts for these contacts when you save, and from that moment on.
extZaloPersonal.connect.checkFailed: We could not check how the login is going. Start over to get a new code.
extZaloPersonal.connect.declined: The login was turned down on the phone. Start over if that was not what you meant.
extZaloPersonal.connect.expired: This code expired before it was scanned. Start over to get a new one.
extZaloPersonal.connect.how: Open Zalo on your phone, tap the QR scanner, and scan this code.
extZaloPersonal.connect.qrAlt: QR code to scan with Zalo on your phone
extZaloPersonal.connect.startFailed: The login could not be started. Try again in a moment.
extZaloPersonal.connect.waiting: Waiting for you to scan the code.
extZaloPersonal.connection.captureNote: You choose which contacts are captured, in the list below. Capture runs forward from when you save — earlier messages are not fetched.
extZaloPersonal.connection.captureOn: On, for the contacts you allowed
extZaloPersonal.connection.disconnectFai: Your account may still be connected. Check the state above before trying again.
extZaloPersonal.connection.needsReconnec: Zalo stopped accepting this connection, so nothing is being captured. Scan a new code with your phone to take it up again.
extZaloPersonal.connection.stranded: A sign-in did not finish, and the Zalo access it created is still held by this installation. Nothing is being captured with it, but the access is real — remove it here, then connect again if you meant to.
extZaloPersonal.connection.sub: Your own personal account. Your Zalo login stays on your phone — it is never shown here, and this screen never asks for it.
extZaloPersonal.connection.title: Your Zalo account
extZaloPersonal.consent.capture: No conversation is captured until you pick one. Connecting only links the account; afterwards you get a list of your Zalo contacts and choose which of them may be captured. Until you allow one and save, nothing from your Zalo reaches the CRM.
extZaloPersonal.consent.noHistory: Capture starts the moment you save those choices, and runs forward from there. Zalo does not hand over your past conversations, so nothing from before today will appear — only messages that arrive from now on, plus whatever Zalo was still holding for you.
extZaloPersonal.consent.personal: This is your own personal account, not a company one. The choices are yours to change or take back, and you can disconnect the account here whenever you like — capture stops the moment you do.
extZaloPersonal.consent.title: Before you connect
extZaloPersonal.consent.zaloWeb: While this is connected, use Zalo on your phone rather than Zalo Web. Zalo Web signs in as the same account, and the two sessions push each other out — which costs you another scan. Your phone is fine alongside it; it is Zalo Web specifically.
extZaloPersonal.noGrant: You have not been granted access to this connector.
extZaloPersonal.sub: Connect the Zalo account on your phone, so the conversations you allow land on the CRM timeline and you can reply from here.
extZaloPersonal.title: Zalo (your own account)
